title: Keyword Arguments used across all XML readers
description: Arguments present in all XML readers.

record_tag.description: A required string indicating the tag of each 'record' in the XML document.

root_tag.description: A string indicating the tag to find the records in within the XML document.

null_values.description: A container of values to replace with null if encountered in an element.

sanitise_multiline.description: Whether to sanitise (remove newlines and multiple spaces) from multiline fields

encoding.description: Encoding of the XML file. Default: `utf-8-sig`

n_records_to_read.description: The maximum number of records to read from a document

xsd_location.description: The Relative path (to the dischema) for the XSD document.

xsd_error_code.description: Allows you to customise the error code generated in the error report when the XSD check fails.

xsd_error_message.description: Allows you to customise the error message generated in the error report when the XSD check fails.

rules_location.description: Allows you to prefix the directory which contains the XSD document.
